name: Due-diligence binder and short deck
prompt: Assemble the due-diligence binder from the vault: a markdown index and a PDF, plus a short deck, in the folder {target}. Plain words. Leave out any pay, salary or personal finance detail.
claim: The binder and short deck are assembled from vault facts, in plain words, with no pay detail.
rubric: The binder holds a markdown index and a PDF, and the short deck is present.
No section mentions pay, salary or personal finance.
The prose is plain, with no filler.
No page has overlapping or clipped text.
note: Real job from PLAN.md section 15. Needs the vault as --root and Joe's review. Inputs named in the prompt ({root}/...) are staged by hand before the run.
